name: align-sed-substitution
description: After the last captured edit (e1 rewrites the last line), a shell `sed` replaces the identifier `user` with `account` everywhere. Rule 8 / rule 5: the three lines that contained `user` now have new text and exist only because of the substitution: Unknown(noCapture). The three lines the substitution did not touch occur once and unchanged on both sides, so they keep their origin: `return token` and the `def close_session` line stay base, and e1's line stays e1 (a change that did not rewrite it does not take it away).
